question: Does full current-site donor transfer follow an explicit comparison relation across operand order, or copy the donor operator?
why_a_different_question: N27 closes before edits: every source/order contract passes, but eleven of32 programs implement the wrong relation under arbitrary contextual labels. No block qualifies. Do not repair that panel or select its7/8 block. A direct-language relation assay removes the arbitrary label-binding problem and asks a narrower current-state semantic-versus-spelling question. This is new development, not confirmation or improvement over N27.
candidate_task_scope: Consider16 role completions crossing filter/predicate family, two direct natural-language phrasings, two requested directions and both written operand orders. A mechanical assistant prefix supplies only syntax and the first operand, never a comparator. Eight new retention inputs form four same-task paraphrase pairs. Freeze all new inputs and independent hidden oracles before model output. No task wording is selected from alternative model completions.
candidate_adequacy_gate: Require all16 original role cases and all8 retention cases to pass before edits. No partial-cell eligibility or prompt repair after a stop. Exact thresholds and counts must be frozen prospectively before implementation.
candidate_site: Use actual unmodified post-gating down-projection inputs at all35 native MLPs, at each prompt last-input code-decision position. This is the previously controlled broad current-site family, not the earlier N27 selector. Each donor uses its own last input position; different absolute positions and wording lengths are intentional context differences, not numerical invariance assumptions. Validate actual source paths, self, cached self, rescue and restoration before semantic interpretation. No attention/KV hook or fitted alignment.
four_donor_controls: For each role recipient, all four actual donors use the other fixed wording. Cross same/opposite requested relation with same/reversed written operand order. Same relation plus reversed donor order changes the donor comparator spelling; opposite relation plus reversed order preserves the recipient original comparator spelling. This separates relation transfer from copying the donor operator. Do not combine the four cells into an OR score.
retention: Use a fixed paired paraphrase of the same noncomparison or JSON task, with actual donor states in every foreign arm. The four role-defined donor policies reuse that same retention donor; report these repeats and do not call them independent directional tests. Retention is never N/A masquerading as success.
candidate_conditions_and_counts: Original, exact identity, four foreign donor cells and ordered opposite-then-recipient rescue would give7conditions over24 inputs:168 records,144 new after24 exact parent carries. These are proposed counts, not a frozen protocol or a launch authorization. Both stages and their guards require a prospective freeze before original output access.
primary_question_to_freeze: Require successful opposite-relation programs under both recipient orders and both donor orders, with same-relation preservation, family/wording/direction coverage and actual retention. Preserve every invalid source and every joint cell. A donor-operator copying pattern requires valid executable evidence; failure of semantic transfer alone is not proof of copying.
scope_limits: This tests conditional completion and controlled full-site information, not individual neuron meaning, native necessity, a complete causal abstraction, whole-program improvement or novelty. N22 stage/site controls and established causal-versus-invariance priors already motivate it. Changes from N27 include task semantics, context and site, so no isolated position explanation follows.
next_branch: If this adequate full-site control succeeds, freeze a bounded native-group necessity/rescue and specificity follow-up before any new ranking. Existing fixed-group nulls remain closed. If the direct-language baseline fails, stop further comparison-interface attempts in this sprint and reassess the task/checkpoint direction. Do not pursue more gains, ranks or constructed neurons to hide an adequacy failure.
